screenshots.caption: Starfall Salvage 1.2: Story is selected; use Up/Down to choose a mode and A to begin.
Mission 01 escort: stay close to the crew member and guide them through the room to the dock.
Mission 01 guardian: the HUD announces CORE OPEN - A PULSE; attack during this opening.
Route choice: Power is selected. Use Up/Down and A to choose the first middle bay; both bays remain required.
Arcade sector 10, Ion Gallery: the red beam is active. Wait safely and time the return to the dock.
Sector 12 is secured with 22,500 points and full hull. Bank Haul is selected here; Fly On is the default dock choice.
Optional Arcade rig choice: Keep Current is selected. A fits and flies; B returns to the dock without changing the rig.
Flight Deck: select a mission with Up/Down, choose an unlocked rig with Left/Right, and press A to launch.
